name: awesome-downloader-showcase
description: The Awesome Downloader showcase video, built with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Showcase final.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k --x264-preset=slow && node scripts/finalize.mjs
scripts.render:social: remotion render src/index.ts Social social-1x1.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --x264-preset=slow && node scripts/finalize.mjs
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts Poster poster.png && remotion still src/index.ts Poster poster.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=92
